blurb: Lake Tyee - A Recreation Community Find yourself here! Nestled in the North Cascade Mountains, near the border between the United States and Canada, lies a serene lake resting in the shadow of snow-capped Mt. Baker. Lake Tyee, one of the best kept secrets of the Pacific Northwest.
